name: Scarab of Protection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Turn aside death magic
powers.text: When you fail a save against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect from an Undead, a Reaction and a charge turn it into a success (used automatically).

summary: Advantage on saves against spells; 12 charges to turn failed saves against necromancy and undead into successes.
text: If you hold this beetle-shaped medallion in your hand for 1 round, an inscription appears on its surface revealing its magical nature. It provides two benefits while it is on your person: you have Advantage on saving throws against spells; and the scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead creature, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.
